items.title: Quest’s Expanded Alzheimer’s and Wellness Testing Push Might Change The Case For Investing In DGX
items.summary: In recent months, Renalytix PLC, Humanity Health Inc., and Quest Diagnostics have announced new collaborations and product launches, including a nationwide kidneyintelX.dkd testing program, a Humanity Biological Age wellness add-on on questhealth.com, and expanded AD-Detect blood-based Alzheimer’s tests accessible through Quest’s U.S. collection network. Together, these moves highlight Quest’s push to deepen its role in advanced kidney, brain health, and consumer-oriented wellness testing...
